about.title: About Me
paras: A London-based full stack engineer specialising in building scalable web applications from scratch. I'm well versed in modern engineering practices, utilising AI agentic workflows like Claude Code to accelerate ideation, development, and code reviews.

A detail-oriented problem solver, I take complete end-to-end ownership to deliver secure, reliable software that maps directly to user needs. Whether building from the ground up or improving existing systems, I focus on clear, maintainable solutions that perform reliably at scale.

items.name: embr
items.description: GDPR-compliant marketing site for a London-based fire curtain installation and maintenance specialist. Built with Astro, scoring 95+ across all Lighthouse metrics, and SEO-optimised to drive inbound leads. Microsoft Clarity wired up for behavioural insight, with Attio CRM integration handling form submissions.
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the embr fire protection marketing site

timeline.title: Technologist @ Eklipx
bullets: Second engineering hire building an OTC derivatives platform that enables dealers to price, book, value, and manage the full lifecycle of structured financial products, while providing counterparties with a white-label portal to view their positions and statements.
Building and deploying microservices on Azure Functions (Node.js/TypeScript).
Frontend applications in Angular and React.
Multi-tenant authentication via Azure AD B2C with MSAL.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer @ We Are Sweet
bullets: Full Stack Developer working on projects with varied tech stacks including Laravel, React, Gatsby, NodeJS, WordPress, Ionic and integrating with numerous 3rd party APIs.
Experience managing AWS infrastructure and provisioning using Pulumi (IaC).
Towards the end of this role we moved to a SaaS model where I helped develop a React client for an award winning real-time second screen experience aimed at endurance sports.

timeline.title: Front End Developer @ Engine Creative & Reydar
bullets: Developed a React 3D & AR product viewer enabling users to visualise products in their own space before purchasing. Used by companies such as Samsung, Howdens, HP and Ultimaker.
Integrated google/model-viewer for 3D rendering and mobile AR capabilities.
Preact client for optimal performance on mobile devices.
AWS S3 blob storage & Lambda to serve models to client.
